question: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: Informations (A) / about the scheme are (B) available online. (C)

Fill in the blank: He divided the sweets _____ the two children.
Find the part of the sentence that has an error: Though he was tired, (A) / but he (B) continued working. (C)
explanation: 'Though' and 'but' should not be used together.

question: Fill in the blank: The train _____ before we reached the platform.

Moreover, it makes receiving salaries and government benefits easier. R. It allows people to save money safely and earn interest on it. S. That is why every adult should open one.
explanation: The opener and connectors fix this order.

question: Fill in the blank: I do not know _____ he will come.

options: know at what time will the meeting start
know what time the meeting will start
know that what time the meeting starts will
know what time will the meeting start
explanation: No inversion in an embedded question.

question: Choose the best replacement for the capitalised part of the sentence: A large number of people WAS present at the rally.
explanation: A large number of takes plural verb.

question: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: The sceneries (A) / of Kashmir are (B) breathtaking. (C)
explanation: Scenery is uncountable; use 'The scenery ... is'.

question: Find the part of the sentence that has an error: Rohan is (A) / one of the best player (B) in our team. (C)
explanation: 'One of the' takes a plural noun: players.
